name: desk_standup_stretch
description: A standing desk stretch routine to relieve tension from prolonged sitting. Includes neck rolls, shoulder shrugs, wrist stretches, and standing back extensions.
tips: Stand up from your desk and step back to give yourself room
Keep your feet shoulder-width apart for stability
Breathe deeply and hold each stretch for 10-15 seconds
Roll your shoulders backward 5 times, then forward 5 times
Gently tilt your head from side to side for neck relief
Extend your arms overhead and interlace your fingers
Bend forward at the waist to stretch your lower back
Repeat the routine every 2 hours during desk work
